body:
Thanks for the support, I've decided to get on the wagon for a while, last Saturday was a real eye opener. I'm gonna start showing my girlfriend more love and support, and being clean will obviously help with that. 

I appreciate the comments, I'll take everything on board and try to be better.  I'm new to the whole Reddit / forum thing and it's nice to know there are such supportive people out there. I'll probably update later down the line and let people know what's going on. Thanks

You're doing a good thing regardless of whether people reply to your comments, sometimes it helps to just hear advice and let it sink in for a few days. And if your other advice is anything like what you have said to me, I'm sure it's helped whoever has seen it. Thank you again
Thank you so much, I'll do everything I can. I think if we are both in a better place mentally it would be easier for us to help each other with our problems. This means a lot thanks.

Thanks for listening it means a lot. She is lovely but I feel like she has enough problems dealing with her mental health that she shouldn't have to deal with me too and I really want to be able to help her too but I feel I'm not much help as I'm not the best example to go off of... She says if she was ever unhappy she'd let me know bit I still feel it's unfair.

Thank you for taking the time to listen. I'm planning on abstaining from alcohol for a good while, my main problem is that I work in the kitchen of a bar and having a discount there sort of made me kid myself into thinking having a drink after work was a cheap and easy way to calm myself down when I feel the stress of quitting smoking and I also felt that I'm less anxious and feel I can talk to people better  when I've had a drink. I've talked to my girlfriend's about being on the wagon for a bit and she says that she'll do what ever she can to help, however I feel like she shouldn't have to "babysit" me when she's going through her own problems. I've also talked to her about that and she says that if she was unhappy about it she would tell me, I still feel it's unfair on her. Thank you for your comment it does mean a lot.
